en.title: Taiwan voters choose thousands of local officials in polls
en.dek: Millions of voters across Taiwan are heading to the polls to decide thousands of local officials, with mayoral races in the capital area being competitive.
facts: Millions of voters across Taiwan are heading to the polls on Saturday to choose thousands of local officials according to Nikkei Asia.
The Democratic Progressive Party's Puma Shen aims to unseat incumbent Taipei Mayor Chiang Wan-an from the Kuomintang according to Nikkei Asia.
The contests in the capital area include competitive mayoral races between the DPP and KMT according to Nikkei Asia.
body: Millions of voters across Taiwan are heading to the polls on Saturday to choose thousands of local officials according to Nikkei Asia.
The Democratic Progressive Party's Puma Shen aims to unseat incumbent Taipei Mayor Chiang Wan-an from the Kuomintang according to Nikkei Asia.
The spotlight is on competitive mayoral races in the capital area between the DPP and KMT according to Nikkei Asia.
en.context: Millions of voters across Taiwan are heading to the polls to decide close contests between the DPP and KMT according to Nikkei Asia.

de.title: Taiwan wählt tausende lokale Amtsträger
de.dek: Millionen Wähler in Taiwan stimmen am Samstag über tausende lokale Ämter ab, wobei die Rennen um das Bürgermeisteramt in der Hauptstadtregion umkämpft sind.
facts: Millionen Wähler in Taiwan stimmen am Samstag über tausende lokale Ämter ab, gemäß Nikkei Asia.
Der Demokratische Fortschrittspartei-Kandidat Puma Shen will den amtierenden Taipei-Bürgermeister Chiang Wan-an von der Kuomintang besiegen, gemäß Nikkei Asia.
Die Rennen in der Hauptstadtregion umfassen umkämpfte Bürgermeisterwahlen zwischen DPP und KMT, gemäß Nikkei Asia.
body: Millionen von Wählern in Taiwan gehen am Samstag zur Wahl, um tausende lokale Amtsträger zu wählen, so Nikkei Asia.
Puma Shen der Demokratischen Fortschrittspartei will den amtierenden Bürgermeister von Taipeh, Chiang Wan-an der Kuomintang, absetzen, so Nikkei Asia.
Der Fokus liegt auf den wettbewerbsintensiven Bürgermeisterwahlen im Hauptstadtgebiet zwischen der DPP und der KMT, so Nikkei Asia.
de.context: Millionen Wähler in Taiwan stimmen ab, um enge Rennen zwischen DPP und KMT zu entscheiden, gemäß Nikkei Asia.

es.title: Votantes taiwaneses eligen a miles de cargos locales en las urnas
es.dek: Millones de votantes en Taiwán acuden a las urnas para decidir a miles de cargos locales, con elecciones a la alcaldía en el área capitalina muy reñidas.
facts: Millones de votantes en Taiwán acuden a las urnas el sábado para elegir a miles de cargos locales según Nikkei Asia
Puma Shen del Partido Progresista Democrático busca desplazar al actual alcalde de Taipéi, Chiang Wan-an, del Kuomintang según Nikkei Asia
Las contiendas en el área capitalina incluyen elecciones a la alcaldía competitivas entre el PPD y el KMT según Nikkei Asia
body: Millones de votantes en Taiwán se dirigen a las urnas el sábado para elegir a miles de cargos locales, según Nikkei Asia.
El Partido Progresista Democrático de Puma Shen busca destituir al alcalde saliente de Taipei, Chiang Wan-an, del Kuomintang, según Nikkei Asia.
Los focos están puestos en las competitivas carreras por la alcaldía en el área capitalina entre el DPP y el KMT, según Nikkei Asia.
es.context: Millones de votantes en Taiwán acuden a las urnas para decidir contiendas reñidas entre el PPD y el KMT según Nikkei Asia

zh.title: 台湾选民投票选出数千名地方官员
zh.dek: 台湾数百万选民将前往投票站决定数千名地方官员，首都地区的市长选举竞争激烈
facts: 根据日经亚洲报道，台湾数百万选民将于周六投票选出数千名地方官员
根据日经亚洲报道，民进党的沈普玛力图击败现任台北市长蒋万安（国民党）
根据日经亚洲报道，首都地区的竞争包括民进党与国民党之间的激烈市长选举
body: 台湾数百万选民将于周六投票，选出数千名地方官员，据《日经亚洲》报道。
据《日经亚洲》报道，民进党的沈普玛力图推翻国民党现任台北市长蒋万安。
据《日经亚洲》报道，焦点集中在台北都会区民进党与国民党之间的激烈市长选举上。
zh.context: 根据日经亚洲报道，台湾数百万选民将前往投票站决定民进党与国民党之间的胶着竞争

it.title: Gli elettori taiwanesi scelgono migliaia di funzionari locali alle elezioni
it.dek: Milioni di elettori in Taiwan si recano alle urne per decidere migliaia di funzionari locali, con gare per la carica di sindaco nell'area della capitale molto combattute.
facts: Milioni di elettori in Taiwan si recano alle urne sabato per eleggere migliaia di funzionari locali secondo Nikkei Asia
Puma Shen del Partito Progressista Democratico mira a sfidare il sindaco uscente di Taipei, Chiang Wan-an, del Kuomintang secondo Nikkei Asia
Le competizioni nell'area della capitale includono gare per la carica di sindaco combattute tra DPP e KMT secondo Nikkei Asia
body: Milioni di elettori in tutta Taiwan si recano ai seggi sabato per scegliere migliaia di funzionari locali, secondo Nikkei Asia.
Il Partito democratico progressista di Puma Shen mira a spodestare il sindaco uscente di Taipei Chiang Wan-an del Kuomintang, secondo Nikkei Asia.
L'attenzione è sulle competitive gare per la carica di sindaco nella zona capitale tra DPP e KMT, secondo Nikkei Asia.
it.context: Milioni di elettori in Taiwan si recano alle urne per decidere i serrati scontri tra DPP e KMT secondo Nikkei Asia

ja.title: 台湾の有権者が数千の地方公職者を選挙で投票
ja.dek: 台湾全土の数百万人の有権者が地方公職者数千名の選出に投票へ、首都圏の市長選は接戦模様
facts: 台湾全土の数百万人の有権者が土曜日に地方公職者数千名の選出に投票へ（日経アジア）
民主進歩党の沈普馬氏は、国民党の現職台北市長・蔣萬安氏の打倒を目指す（日経アジア）
首都圏の選挙では、民進党と国民党による接戦の市長選が行われる（日経アジア）
body: [paragraph 3]  No title, because nothing before the first marker.  Now translate the paragraphs:  1. "Millions of voters across Taiwan are heading to the polls on Saturday to choose thousands of local officials according to Nikkei Asia." → 台湾全土で数百万人の有権者が土曜日に投票所へ向かい、数千人の地方公職者を選ぶ。日経アジアによると。 Or more naturally: 日経アジアによると、台湾全土の数百万人の有権者が土曜日に投票所に足を運び、数千人の地方公職者を選ぶ。 Quality newspaper style: 日経アジアによると、台湾全土で数百万人の有権者が土曜日、投票所に足を運び、数千人に上る地方公職者を選ぶ。  2. "The Democratic Progressive Party's Puma Shen aims to unseat incumbent Taipei Mayor Chiang Wan-an from the Kuomintang according to Nikkei Asia." → 日経アジアによると、民主進歩党の沈伯洋（シェン・ボーヤン/Puma Shen）は、国民党の現職台北市長・蔣万安（チアン・ワンアン）の議席を奪うことを目指している。 Wait, established local spelling: Puma Shen is 沈伯洋 (Shěn Bóyáng). Chiang Wan-an is 蔣万安 (Jiǎng Wàn'ān).
ja.context: 台湾全土の数百万人の有権者が、民進党と国民党の接戦の行方を決めるために投票へ向かう（日経アジア）

problemsFixed: The headline uses a colon-for-drama and is not a purely factual statement of what happened.
The dek is not a single-sentence summary, max 30 words.

The facts list contains repetition and unsupported claims (e.g., 'New Taipei and other areas are deciding contests between the DPP and KMT parties' is not explicitly stated as a fact in S4, only that millions are voting across Taiwan).
The body repeats information from the facts and includes evaluative framing ('with all eyes on the capital area races that could signal broader political trends').
The context is evaluative and speculative, not purely factual background from the sources.
The structure is repetitive and lacks the required rhythm (varying sentence length, no four short declarative sentences in a row).
